nodes.description: Reentrancy lock flag of UnicSwapV2Pair; 1 means unlocked, 0 means locked.

Cached reserve of token1, stored as uint112 in a packed slot.

Cumulative price of token1 accumulator, written with unchecked arithmetic.

View function returning reserve0, reserve1 and blockTimestampLast.
Private helper that performs a low-level token.call with selector transfer(address,uint256).

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal the stored factory before token addresses can be initialized.
The factory address is taken directly from msg.sender at deployment time.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance[from][msg.sender].
msg.sender is forwarded to the swap callback as sender and used in the Swap event.
permit requires deadline >= block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is reduced modulo 2**32 and used in cumulative price arithmetic.
_update writes the current blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast.
price0CumulativeLast is increased with unchecked multiplication and addition.
price1CumulativeLast is increased with unchecked multiplication and addition.
_update stores uint112(balance0) into reserve0.
_update stores uint112(balance1) into reserve1.
_update performs the unchecked oracle accumulator arithmetic flagged as unsafe.
_update performs the intentionally wrapping uint32 timestamp subtraction.
swap optimistically sends output tokens through _safeTransfer before verifying balances.
swap invokes an arbitrary user contract via unicSwapV2Call before reading balances and updating reserves.
A malicious callee can reenter swap (or mint/burn) during the unicSwapV2Call callback.
swap calls _update to refresh reserves after the token transfers.
burn pays out underlying tokens using _safeTransfer.
burn destroys the LP tokens held by the pair via _burn.
burn calls _mintFee before computing pro-rata amounts.
mint calls _mintFee before computing the liquidity to mint.
mint issues LP tokens through the internal _mint helper.
mint calls _update after minting LP tokens.
mint reads the cached reserves with getReserves().
burn reads the cached reserves with getReserves().
swap reads the cached reserves with getReserves().
_safeTransfer delegates to a low-level token.call that can execute arbitrary callee code.
_mintFee queries IUnicSwapV2Factory(factory).feeTo().
_mintFee reads and, when the fee is off, clears kLast.
_mintFee mints protocol-fee LP tokens when sqrt(k) grew.
_mint increases totalSupply.
_mint increases balanceOf[to].
_burn decreases totalSupply.
_burn decreases balanceOf[from].
permit relies on ecrecover and rejects signatures that do not match owner.
permit consumes and increments nonces[owner].
permit embeds DOMAIN_SEPARATOR in the EIP-712 digest.
permit grants an allowance on behalf of the recovered owner.
transferFrom decrements allowance[from][msg.sender] unless it is uint(-1).
initialize writes the token0 address (factory-only).
initialize writes the token1 address (factory-only).
skim sends the surplus of each token with _safeTransfer.
sync calls _update with fresh balances.
sync reads the token0 balance of the pair.
sync reads the token1 balance of the pair.
The lock modifier reads and toggles unlocked to serialize mint.
The lock modifier reads and toggles unlocked to serialize burn.
The lock modifier reads and toggles unlocked to serialize swap.
The lock modifier reads and toggles unlocked to serialize skim.
The lock modifier reads and toggles unlocked to serialize sync.
skim subtracts reserve0 from the current token0 balance.
skim subtracts reserve1 from the current token1 balance.
swap compares output amounts against reserve0.
swap compares output amounts against reserve1.
The mint recipient parameter flows into mint().
mint's local amounts are computed and stored inside mint().
The burn recipient parameter flows into burn().
burn's local amounts are computed and stored inside burn().
swap's output amounts and recipient are consumed by swap().
swap's local balance and invariant variables are computed inside swap().
The skim recipient parameter flows into skim().
The token address parameters are assigned to token0 and token1 in initialize().
The permit parameters are hashed and verified inside permit().
The from/to/value parameters drive the allowance and balance updates in transferFrom().
_update's timestamp locals carry block.timestamp into the reserve/oracle update.
_update's balance and reserve parameters are written back to storage.
_mintFee's locals hold the sqrt(k) growth computation and minted liquidity.
_mint's to/value parameters drive the totalSupply and balanceOf updates.
_burn's from/value parameters drive the balanceOf and totalSupply updates.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter of mint() has no independent security semantics and is absorbed into its enclosing function node.
All mint() temporaries derive from storage reads and balance calls and are internal to the mint function.
The recipient parameter of burn() only determines where the withdrawn tokens are sent and is internal to burn.
All burn() temporaries are computed inside burn() and are absorbed into the burn function node.
The swap output/recipient/data parameters are consumed entirely inside swap() and have no standalone effect.
All swap() temporaries are local invariant math and are absorbed into the swap function node.
The skim() recipient parameter is only used as the transfer target inside skim().
The initialize() token parameters are directly written into token0/token1 by the initializer.
The permit() parameters are hashed and validated inside permit() and have no independent state effect.
The transferFrom() parameters feed allowance and balance updates inside transferFrom().
The timestamp temporaries are arithmetic inside _update feeding the oracle accumulator writes.
The balance/reserve parameters are written directly to reserve0/reserve1 by _update().
The _mintFee() locals hold the sqrt(k) fee computation and are absorbed into _mintFee.
The internal _mint helper parameters directly update totalSupply and balanceOf.
The internal _burn helper parameters directly update balanceOf and totalSupply.
